_comment: Cards that exist only for the total-mana-value test (tests/unit/test_total_mana_value.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_flames_of_rebirth` is Phoenix, Warden of Fire's third chapter: a cap on the picks TOGETHER. `t_each_six` is the counterfactual -- the same line read as a cap on each of them, which is what a selector clause can say and is a much wider card.

cards.name: Test Flames of Rebirth
cards.oracle_text: Return any number of target creature cards with total mana value 6 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
